verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's docs index lists a first-party Mission Control Agent for investigating your environment, which suggests in-product AI analysis of the user's infrastructure. That is only a single thin mention, with no detail on what insights or suggestions it produces. The billing insights and Grafana dashboards are not AI-generated, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of what data the agent analyzes, concrete examples of AI-generated insights or recommendations, how the agent is used inside the Cloud Console, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Mission Control Agent and the Mission Control MCP server for investigating your environment and making supported changes.
